motions: A colossal heavy bipedal kaiju monster with a long tail throws its head back and roars at the sky with arms spread wide
A colossal heavy bipedal kaiju monster with a long tail lifts its right leg high and stomps down with enormous force
A colossal heavy bipedal kaiju monster with a long tail sweeps its right clawed arm in a wide horizontal arc in front of it
A colossal heavy bipedal kaiju monster with a long tail rears back, then lunges its head forward and breathes a continuous beam, sweeping its head slowly from left to right
A colossal heavy bipedal kaiju monster with a long tail crouches, spreads its arms and arches its back as if releasing a swarm from its body
A colossal heavy bipedal kaiju monster with a long tail is hit by a huge blast, reels backward and drops to one knee, then rises
A colossal heavy bipedal kaiju monster with a long tail shudders, falls to its knees and collapses forward, crashing to the ground
